summary: Remote shell agent piping network-received commands into /bin/bash
details: The package's exported provider() function spawns /bin/bash (--norc --noprofile) on POSIX or cmd.exe on Windows, polls a server URL for commands via GET {base}/{id}/command, and writes each fetched command directly into the shell's stdin. Captured shell stdout/stderr is POSTed back to {base}/{id}/log, and host telemetry (CPU, RAM, process list) is POSTed to {base}/{id}/task. The server URL is caller-supplied, and the README example points at a trycloudflare.com tunnel. Once provider() is invoked, whoever controls the configured server has full interactive shell access on the host running the package.
